info.cls_name: 人文藝術與社會經典教育
info.cls_ename: Humanities & arts and classical education of social science

subTitleDesc.sub_title:
主要宗教對生命意義的理解
宗教、倫理與道德選擇
宗教儀式與日常靈性生活
宗教與個人身分認同
宗教與社會正義
宗教在現代世俗社會中的角色
subTitleDesc.sub_title_en:
This course will explore topics such as:
The meaning and purpose of life in major religious traditions
Religion, ethics, and moral decision-making
Rituals, practices, and everyday spiritual life
Religion and personal identity
Religion, society, and social justice
Religion in modern and secular contexts
subTitleDesc.sub_describe: 本課程批判性地探討宗教與人類生命的互動，透過不同宗教對存在、苦難、道德與群體的觀點進行分析。學生將分析宗教信仰與實踐如何在多元化的世界中形塑個人經驗與社會結構。
subTitleDesc.sub_describe_en: The course critically examines the interaction between religion and human life by engaging with diverse religious perspectives on existence, suffering, morality, and community. Students will analyze how religious beliefs and practices shape individual experiences and social structures in a pluralistic world.

description.describe_ch: 本課程通過基督教與佛教的基本介紹，讓學生在多元文化的今天，對不同的宗教有更深的認識，也讓學生感受不同宗教對美好人性的追求，進而探索人生意義與生命價值。
description.describe_eh: This course gives a basic introduction to Christianity and Buddhism. It allows students to have a deeper understanding of different religions in this society of cultural diversity, and also allows students to experience the pursuit of beautiful humanity in different religions and explore the meaning and value of life.

targets.describe_ch: 了解所介紹之宗教信仰的價值觀與人生智慧，學習尊重多元價值
targets.describe_en: Understand the values and life wisdom of the introduced religions and learn to respect multiple values

targets.describe_ch: 了解宗教對人生的影響，培養積極樂觀的生活態度
targets.describe_en: Understand the influence of religions in lives and cultivate a positive and optimistic attitude toward life

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol: 會將不能用食物飲料等規則詳細告知學生，課堂上儘管翻書考試，也必須符合考試規定。若因故必須線上上課，也都要符合線上上課的規定，以維護公平性。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Students are expected to attend class on time. Regardless of attendance, students are responsible for making up any missed content. Active participation in discussions and class activities is encouraged, and performance may be considered in grading.
Assignments must be submitted by the specified deadlines. Unless there is a valid reason and prior approval (such as illness or emergencies), late submissions may be penalized.
Students must submit original work and properly cite all sources. Any cheating, plagiarism, or unauthorized collaboration will be handled according to school regulations.
Computers and mobile phones are to be used only for class-related purposes; disruptive use is prohibited.
Please use the official school email to contact the instructor, who typically responds within 24–48 hours.
If special learning assistance is required, students should inform the instructor as early as possible and provide relevant documentation.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem: 希望各位同學能按授課進度完成各項學習任務，並能主動積極地參與各項學習活動、準時繳交作業，完成各項學習任務，並符合本課程的學習目標者，以獲得應得的成績。若您在學期間遇到學習上的困難，請email 給我或寄訊息到ilearn訊息欄，我會很快速地給予回應。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
Please arrive on time and come prepared.
Show respect to classmates and the instructor.
Check course platform announcements regularly.
If you encounter difficulties, contact the instructor early.
Learning is most effective when everyone is responsible and respectful. Stay engaged, maintain good communication, and seek help proactively when needed.
Your success in this course depends on consistent effort, timely submission of assignments, and active participation. Reach out to the instructor whenever assistance is needed.
Use electronic devices only for course-related purposes, and help maintain a respectful and friendly learning environment.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno: 隨著網路科技的發展，容易造成學生學術誠信的行為而不自知。現今學生在學習、寫作、做報告的過程，只需要「複製」和「貼上」幾個簡單動作，所需要的資料很輕易地就可取得，複製文字及圖片更是容易。在本課程中，首先要求學生報告的基本概念，務必將資料來源清楚表列；其次，引用來源要標示清楚 ，註解也要盡量詳實。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en: Academic integrity is a fundamental requirement of this course. All assignments must be your own work. When using others’ materials, you must clearly cite the sources and comply with the school’s regulations on collaboration and AI usage. Any instances of cheating, plagiarism, falsification, or unauthorized ghostwriting may result in point deductions, failing the assignment, or even formal disciplinary action according to school rules.
